name: Mishuku Hinako
source:
The real Hinako Mishuku was a middle school student and one of the 20 participants in the Death Game. She died during the First Trial. 

[spoiler] In her last moments, she thanked Rio Ranger when she realized that he was involved with her death (which lead him to abuse her corpse). This also shows that she had some sort of suicidal ideation.   [/spoiler]
translation:
The real Hinako Mishuku was a middle school student and one of the 20 participants in the Death Game. She died during the First Trial.
